text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=hosted-inference-prod, incident=INC-9621, trigger=latency_spike. 95th latency = 2.3s (baseline 0.18s). Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-9621
ashok: acked via PD — I'm on it. seeing the alert, pulling traces.
maria: pinged via slack DM to check availability in case you need help @ashok.
ashok: thanks — initial look shows a sudden queueing spike on the batcher, CPU on g4 nodes at ~92%. KV cache eviction spiked.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: primary ack received at 6078901240. Escalation timer started (secondary=10m).
ashok: running quick diag. `kubectl top pods -n inference | grep batcher` shows one pod at 1.6 CPU. scaling events?
sabrina: checking autoscaler logs now. nothing showing recent scale up in the last 5m.
leo: if batcher can't scale we should fail-over to smaller batch sizes. can someone flip the routing rule to avoid large batch payloads?
maria: I'm coming onto the call. if primary can't get to it in 5m i'll take over.
ashok: trying a hot-restart of the batcher pod to clear backlog. running: 
```
kubectl delete pod inference-batcher-5f8d -n inference --grace-period=0 --force
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-batcher -n inference
```
ashok: restart started.
incident-bot: Incident update: no response to follow-up check-in. PagerDuty escalated to secondary at 6078901298.
pagerduty-bot: Auto-escalation: secondary (maria) notified. Manager escalation will fire in 8m if unacknowledged.
maria: acked via PD at 6078901305 — joining. site impact? any customer-visible errors?
sabrina: metrics: error rate (5xx) up from 0.4% -> 11% for requests to /generate, increased client timeouts ~6%. approx 12% of traffic affected in last 5m.
leo: tagging customer-impact: partial. notify support to open a customer advisory? @oncall-manager, decision?
oncall-manager: please draft a one-line advisory: "We are investigating increased latency and intermittent errors for text generation; partial impact to some requests. Will update in 30 mins." hold until we confirm mitigation.
maria: restart of batcher completed, but we still see backlog — looks like a KV cache eviction storm on the model shard causing repeated cold-starts. logs show repeated OOM-ish evictions. snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T14:18:23Z model-shard-3: KVCache evicted 4096 entries
2026-03-15T14:18:24Z model-shard-3: reload weights, allocate 6.1GB
2026-03-15T14:18:24Z model-shard-3: Eviction thrash detected, mem pressure high
```
ashok: rolling back to quantized model variant r1-q4 to reduce memory. plan: change routing policy for production to r1-q4 for the affected cohort. I can push the route in 2m.
maria: good call. if that doesn't stabilize, shift traffic to secondary region (us-west-2) where we have spare capacity.
leo: I'm on the bridge. joining call now @ashok @maria.
ashok: pushing route change: `redwoodctl route update --service hosted-inference-prod --model r1-q4 --filter '/generate' --percentage 100`
incident-bot: config change detected by deploybot — route update triggered by ashok at 6078901342.
sabrina: metrics: after route change, p95 dropped to 0.28s, error rate falling to 2.5% over last 45s. partial recovery.
oncall-manager: confirm we should keep advisory draft private until we see stable 10m window. if stable, we'll publish a short advisory.
maria: agree. still watching KV churn, but routing to quantized variant reduced mem pressure on shard-3. I'll keep monitoring logs for 20m.
ashok: leaving note for postmortem: root cause likely a regression in cache behavior in runtime 1.4.3 — triggered under high concurrency. will open an eval and a unit test for KV churn.
leo: great. postmortem owner? assigning to ashok + maria. include runbook step to auto-fallback to quantized models when eviction_rate > 1000/min.
ashok: taking PM duties. I'll create INC-9621 on Confluence and link.
incident-bot: Incident resolved flag not set. waiting for confirmation.
sabrina: marking metrics stable for 5m window, no new evictions. recommend close in 15m if there are no regressions.
oncall-manager: agreed. I'll coordinate customer communication if we clear the 15m window. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
leo: thumbs. good handoff.
